## Welcome to Arc 1

- First stop in the ARCS series.
- For the full schedule, facilitators, and logistics, see the **[Schedule](../schedule.qmd)** page — we'll keep this session focused on getting you coding.

## Why Reproducibility?

::: {.incremental}
- You've probably heard — or said — "it works on my machine."
- A script runs perfectly for you, then breaks the moment someone else opens it.
- A different computer, a missing package, a moved file — and the result changes, or the code stops running entirely.
- **Reproducibility** means your analysis runs the same way, for anyone, on any machine, at any time.
- Every habit in this series — from how we name files to how we write code — exists to prevent that gap.
:::
